title: Choice of God, Thou Blessed Day
description: Choice of God, Thou Blessed Day in Tonic Solfa to PLEYEL'S HYMN, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Hannah Flagg Gould wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 59 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Sabbath”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to PLEYEL'S HYMN; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Choice of God, thou bless-ed day, At thy dawn the grave gave way To the power of him with-in, Who had, sin-less, bled for sin.

lines: Choice of God, thou blessed day,
At thy dawn the grave gave way
To the power of him within,
Who had, sinless, bled for sin.
First, for man, the dismal tomb,
When its bars their weakness owned,
Rose, a darkened world to bless,
Day of glory, day of power,

licence: Public domain: Hannah Flagg Gould died in 1865.
credits: Words by Hannah Flagg Gould (1789–1865), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to PLEYEL'S HYMN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
